title: Ceramic Sherd
brief_description: Fragment of a ceramic vessel recovered from an archaeological context.
detailed_description: This ceramic sherd is a fragment of a larger pottery vessel used for domestic, storage, serving, or ceremonial purposes. The fragment preserves portions of the rim, body, or base and exhibits characteristics such as glaze, painted decoration, or surface finishing that assist archaeologists in identifying its origin, manufacturing technique, and approximate age. Ceramic fragments are among the most common archaeological discoveries and provide valuable evidence for understanding trade, craftsmanship, daily life, food practices, and cultural interactions in historic Goa. Decorative motifs, fabric composition, and firing techniques help determine the vessel's chronology and historical significance.
